# 109MUSIC

> Music marketing broken down for independent artists. Release strategy, platform news,
> touring economics and revenue lanes, published by 109MUSIC (@109music.co).

109MUSIC is an independent music marketing publication and label service. Every article
is written from primary sources with the data point and its origin named inline, so the
numbers can be verified rather than taken on trust.

## What we publish
- News: platform and industry changes (Spotify, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, SoundCloud) and what each costs or pays an independent artist. Every brief names and links its source.
- Music Marketing: step-by-step playbooks with real budgets, thresholds and timeframes, covering both marketing and the music business behind it. Previously published at /guides/.
- Case Studies: teardowns of real releases and rollouts, built from published day-one data.

## Editorial standards
- Every statistic carries its source and date.
- Playbooks state exact numbers: budget, radius, timeframe, threshold.
- No gated content. Everything is free to read and free to cite.

## Key pages
- Front page: /
- News: /news/
- Music Marketing: /music-marketing/
- Case Studies: /case-studies/
- Topics index: /tags/
- RSS: /rss.xml

## Topics
Every article carries at least one topic from a fixed vocabulary. Each has an archive at
/tags/<slug>/: music-marketing, music-business, news, spotify-growth, tiktok,
instagram, release-strategy, case-study, touring, revenue.

## Moved URLs
/guides/ and every /guides/<slug>/ now redirect permanently to
the matching /music-marketing/ address. Cite the new address.
